security_audit.summary: The skill is a Context7 documentation helper, but it directs agents to run external npx ctx7 commands, manage skills, change setup, and use authentication commands. I found no prompt injection, no real embedded secret, and no evidence of credential exfiltration in SKILL.md. Publication should require clear user confirmation for external commands and local environment changes.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the ctx7 package version or require user confirmation before any npx command runs.

remediation.issue: Skill installation and setup side effects
remediation.suggestion: Move skills install, install --all, and setup commands behind explicit user requests with clear side effect warnings.
State that keys should be managed outside chat and that login, logout, and whoami commands require user approval.

content.user_title: Fetch Current Library Docs with Context7
content.value_statement: Developers need current library guidance when APIs change quickly. This skill uses the Context7 CLI to resolve libraries, fetch docs, and surface implementation examples.
actual_capabilities: Resolve library names to Context7 library IDs using ctx7 library.
Fetch current documentation and examples with ctx7 docs.
Query version-specific documentation when a versioned library ID is available.
Return JSON output for scripted documentation lookups.
Document Context7 skill search, install, list, and generate commands.
Document Context7 login, logout, and account status commands.
limitations: Requires network access and the ctx7 CLI package through npm or npx.
Results depend on Context7 index coverage and source quality.
Some skills management and generation commands require authentication.
Setup and install commands can modify local tool configuration.

use_cases.title: Check Current API Usage
use_cases.description: Fetch current docs before implementing a framework feature or fixing deprecated code.

use_cases.title: Research Dependency Changes
use_cases.description: Compare library IDs, versions, and examples before planning an upgrade or migration.

use_cases.title: Enable Agent Documentation Lookup
use_cases.description: Use Context7 from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code when an agent needs current external documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Library ID
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Context7 to find the best library ID for React. Summarize why the top result is the best match.

prompt_templates.title: Fetch Focused API Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Context7 docs for React to answer how to clean up useEffect with async work. Keep the answer concise.

prompt_templates.title: Check Versioned Framework Docs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Context7 to find a Next.js v14 library ID, then fetch docs about app router middleware behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Automate a Docs Lookup
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Context7 JSON output to resolve a library ID, then fetch docs for that ID. Explain each command before running it.

output_examples.input: Find the Context7 library ID for React hooks documentation.
output_examples.output: The best match is the React library ID. The result has strong source reputation and a large set of indexed snippets.

output_examples.input: Fetch documentation about Next.js middleware redirects.
output_examples.output: The answer summarizes the current middleware behavior, shows the relevant routing concept, and notes version-specific considerations.

output_examples.input: Research Prisma one-to-many relations with cascade delete.
output_examples.output: The result explains the relation model, cascade behavior, and the migration considerations to review before implementation.

best_practices: Confirm with the user before running npx, install, setup, login, or logout commands.
Use precise library IDs and natural language questions for better matches.
Prefer pinned CLI versions when repeatable results are important.
anti_patterns: Running skills install --all without reviewing what will be installed.
Sharing API keys, tokens, or login codes in the chat transcript.
Using broad one-word queries when a specific implementation question is known.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an agent to use the Context7 CLI to find library IDs and fetch current documentation.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Most lookup commands do not require a key. Some authenticated or higher-limit workflows may need Context7 authentication.

faq.question: Does it run shell commands?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents npx ctx7 commands, so agents should ask before running commands with side effects.

faq.question: Can it install other skills?
faq.answer: It documents Context7 skills install commands. Users should approve each install action before it runs.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when the environment allows shell command execution.

faq.question: What are the main limitations?
faq.answer: It depends on network access, npm package availability, and the quality of the Context7 documentation index.
